messages:
Ana (PM): Polaris sent a trimmed asset pack for the co-marketing tile. Need quick sanity: logo lockups, hero art size, alt text, and quote language. Link: https://files.redwood.example/polaris-lite.zip
Ravi (Design): on it. quick check: they gave horizontal + stacked. which do we prefer for the marketplace tile?
Marina (Partner Ops): Polaris asked horizontal on listing, stacked for badges. attached brand-guidelines-lite.pdf.
Ravi (Design): found a color mismatch in one of their PNGs. use #0B4F8C per guide. hero art: request 1600x600 PNG and a 1:1 crop for social. alt text draft: "Polaris Compute dashboard with Redwood inference latency overlay"
Sam (Legal): alt text looks fine. They shared a trademark note: include TM on first mention only, don't alter logos. Also avoid numeric claims without methodology.
Jeff (Marketing): quote draft from Polaris: "Redwood + Polaris cut inference time significantly in our internal tests." Polaris prefers no ratio on the tile; they'll approve stats in an appendix.
Ana (PM): okay. we'll publish teaser copy now and swap in stats when appendix is ready. Timeline: publish slot tomorrow morning.
Ravi (Design): I'll export horizontal lockup + 1:1 social badges and upload optimized JPG/PNG/SVG.
asset-bot: Upload complete: polaris-lite-hero.zip (3.2MB)  https://files.redwood.example/polaris-lite-hero.zip
Jeff (Marketing): Marketplace tile copy: "Redwood + Polaris: simplified, low-latency inference." CTA: "Read the tech brief". Sam ok with CTA?
Sam (Legal): CTA fine as long as we don't promise guaranteed numbers.
Marina (Partner Ops): Action items: Jeff to confirm teaser wording with Polaris, Ravi to upload final art, Ana to prepare appendix skeleton, Sam to provide microcopy constraints, I'll schedule publish.
Ravi (Design): Uploading final assets now.
asset-bot: Upload complete: polaris-lockups-and-badges.zip (2.6MB)  https://files.redwood.example/polaris-lockups-and-badges.zip
Jeff (Marketing): Polaris approved teaser. Appendix due next Tue.
Ana (PM): Great. Everyone react with :thumbsup: once your action is done.
Ravi (Design): :thumbsup:
Jeff (Marketing): :thumbsup:
Sam (Legal): :thumbsup:
Marina (Partner Ops): :thumbsup:
Ana (PM): Thanks team, moving to publish queue.
